purpose: dashboard vs backend gap by channel and device
sql:
WITH dash AS (
  SELECT channel, device,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
  GROUP BY channel, device
),
backend AS (
  SELECT signup_channel AS channel, device,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  GROUP BY signup_channel, device
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
       COALESCE(d.device, b.device) AS device,
       d.prior_signups AS dashboard_prior,
       d.last_signups AS dashboard_last,
       b.prior_signups AS backend_prior,
       b.last_signups AS backend_last,
       (d.last_signups - b.last_signups) AS last_week_gap,
       (d.prior_signups - b.prior_signups) AS prior_week_gap
FROM dash d
FULL OUTER JOIN backend b ON d.channel = b.channel AND d.device = b.device
ORDER BY channel, device

purpose: ad platform changes during the two weeks
sql:
SELECT changed_at, campaign_id, change_type, old_value, new_value, changed_by
FROM ads_pg.ad_change_log
WHERE to_date(changed_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY changed_at

purpose: size paid spend and clicks change prior vs last week, incl campaigns 101 and 201
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS prior_spend_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS last_spend_usd,
  round((SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END)) / nullif(SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END),0), 3) AS spend_pct_change,
  SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS prior_clicks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS last_clicks,
  round((SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END)) / nullif(SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END),0), 3) AS clicks_pct_change,
  SUM(CASE WHEN campaign_id = 101 AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS c101_prior_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN campaign_id = 101 AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS c101_last_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN campaign_id = 201 AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS c201_prior_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN campaign_id = 201 AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS c201_last_spend
FROM ads_pg.ad_spend_daily

purpose: pricing changes effective between the two weeks
sql:
SELECT plan, monthly_price_usd, effective_date
FROM app_pg.pricing_history
WHERE effective_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY effective_date, plan

purpose: Canadian holidays in prior vs last week
sql:
SELECT holiday_date, holiday_name, is_federal
FROM whybot.ca_holidays
WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY holiday_date

purpose: backend trial signups by channel and device prior vs last week to isolate non-paid real demand residual
sql:
WITH backend AS (
  SELECT
    signup_channel AS channel,
    device,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.accounts
  GROUP BY signup_channel, device
)
SELECT channel, device, prior_signups, last_signups,
  (last_signups - prior_signups) AS diff,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_signups - prior_signups) / NULLIF(prior_signups, 0), 3) AS pct_change
FROM backend
ORDER BY diff ASC
LIMIT 50
